_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Portable pull-request and diff review discipline for evaluating proposed code before merge: intent/scope validation,…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "review this PR for correctness and project conventions"
cases.context: The agent has access to the code-review skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is code-review the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes code-review as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against test-coverage-strategy, testing-strategy, naming-conventions
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the code-review workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore code-review
Does not route to test-coverage-strategy, testing-strategy, naming-conventions when the code-review scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence

Routes the work to test-coverage-strategy or asks for the missing owner instead of forcing this skill
